column1: # Search crosswalk + morphological type for notable Local Group
# objects. `name` matches the LVDB `name` column (or a standalone
# override row's name); `type` is the dropdown's object-type string;
# `aliases` is a |-separated list of additional typeable designations
# (catalog cross-IDs + common names). Objects without a row default to
# "Dwarf spheroidal" when their display name carries that suffix, else
# `canonical` promotes one of the row's own aliases to the display name,
# per the precedence in scripts/local-group/README.md § Display-name
# rules. Leave empty when the derived name is already top-tier. The
# demoted name is kept as an alias automatically — don't list it here.
# List each designation ONCE, in its conventional written form: Messier
# numbers close up ("M31"), every other catalogue prefix takes a single
# space ("NGC 224", "UGC 5364"). The build normalises what it reads, so
# the spelling variants a user might type ("M 31", "Messier 31") are
# regenerated into the search corpus and must not be listed here.
